## Overview {.unnumbered}

The Scripps Pelagic Invertebrate Collection (PIC) holds the invertebrate
portion of the CalCOFI net samples; SWFSC sorts the same nets for fish eggs and
larvae. This notebook gives each PIC **Parent Net Event** (PNE) the SWFSC
**NetId** of the net (cod end) it came from, so PIC records can link to the
ichthyoplankton counts and the other net-level data.

It is part 2 of the matching begun in February
([first pass](https://calcofi.io/workflows/explore_scripps.ucsd.edu_pelagic-invertebrate-collection.html)),
which matched by tow. As Ed Weber pointed out, a bongo tow fills two nets, often
starboard to formaldehyde and port to ethanol, so a tow-level match cannot say
which NetId a PIC record belongs to. Here the match is **per net**:

- **Inputs.** Linsey Sala's PNE table of 2026-10-19 (CalCOFI expeditions only)
  and the SWFSC nets **as released** in the CalCOFI integrated database, so
  cruises, ships, NODC codes and stations are in the database's cleaned
  vocabulary, not the raw SWFSC export.
- **Scope.** CalCOFI proper, 1951 onward (Ed Weber: the 1949–50 nets are not
  part of the standard SWFSC data). Net types SWFSC does not sort for
  ichthyoplankton (PRPOOS, HSN, ring nets, …) stay in the crosswalk, marked
  `not_sorted`, so they still join the wider interoperability work.
- **Rules** (`libs/pic_net_match.R`, asserted by
  `tests/testthat/test-pic_net_match.R`):
  1. the PIC net type maps to an SWFSC tow type, which must agree;
  2. a candidate tow is at the same station (line + station) within 36 h, or
     within 5 km and 12 h;
  3. the station match ranks first, then the nearest time, then distance;
  4. the preservative picks the net: formaldehyde is the starboard net, ethanol
     the port net; a tow with a single net gives that net;
  5. each SWFSC net goes to one PIC record only; a losing claim is a `conflict`.
- **Checks.** The time difference of station matches must sit at zero
  (it would show a time-zone slip). The 139 PNE records that already carry
  SWFSC's NetId must be reproduced wherever their nets are in the release.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(
  CalCOFI/calcofi4db, CalCOFI/calcofi4r,
  DBI, dplyr, DT, fs, glue, here, leaflet, lubridate, readr, readxl, stringr,
  tidyr,
  quiet = T)
options(readr.show_col_types = F)
options(DT.options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))

source(here("libs/ingest.R"))          # dir_data
source(here("libs/pic_net_match.R"))

# the release to match against: latest, or a candidate via the release env vars
version <- Sys.getenv("CALCOFI_RELEASE_VERSION", "latest")

dir_pic  <- path_expand(glue("{dir_data}/scripps/pelagic-invertebrate-collection"))
pne_xlsx <- path(dir_pic, "SIOPIC_DB_PNEtable_CalCOFI_19Oct2026.xlsx")
fld_xlsx <- path(dir_pic, "SIOPIC_DB_PNEtable_fieldDetails_9Feb2026_update19Oct2026.xlsx")
stopifnot(file_exists(pne_xlsx), file_exists(fld_xlsx))

dir_out <- calcofi4db::cc_stage_path("crosswalk", "sio_pic-zooplankton", create = TRUE)
```

## PIC Parent Net Events

### Field details

```{r}
#| label: pne-fields

read_excel(fld_xlsx) |>
  datatable(caption = "PNE fields (Linsey Sala, updated 2026-10-19)")
```

### Read and clean

Dates are local and times are `HHMM` Pacific Standard Time (field details);
they are converted to UTC to compare with the release.

```{r}
#| label: read-pne

pne_raw <- read_excel(pne_xlsx, guess_max = 1e5, col_types = "text") |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, " ", "_"))

pne <- pne_raw |>
  transmute(
    pic_id          = as.integer(ParentNetEventID_pk),
    occurrence_uuid = occurenceID_UUID_pne,
    netid_swfsc     = tolower(NetID_SWFSC),
    expedition      = EXPEDITION_pne,
    expedition_code = EXPED_CODE_pne,
    ship_name       = SHIP_pne,
    line            = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STATION_LINE_pne)),
    station         = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STATION_NUMBER_pne)),
    latitude        = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(LAT_DECIMAL_pne)),
    longitude       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(LONG_DECIMAL_pne)),
    date            = as.Date(as.numeric(SAMPLE_DATE_pne), origin = "1899-12-30"),
    start_hhmm      = START_TIME_pne,
    depth_max_m     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(DEPTH_MAX_pne)),
    net_type        = NET_TYPE_pne,
    tow_type_pic    = TOW_TYPE_pne,
    preservative    = str_to_lower(PRESERVATIVE_pne)) |>
  mutate(
    site_key = if_else(
      is.na(line) | is.na(station), NA_character_,
      sprintf("%05.1f %05.1f", line, station)),
    year     = year(date),
    tow_type = pic_tow_type(net_type),
    net_side = pic_net_side(preservative))
pne <- bind_cols(pne, pic_local_to_utc(pne$date, pne$start_hhmm))

stopifnot(
  "ParentNetEventID_pk is unique"   = !anyDuplicated(pne$pic_id),
  "every record has a sample date" = !anyNA(pne$date))

cat(glue(
  "{format(nrow(pne), big.mark = ',')} PNE records, ",
  "{min(pne$year)}–{max(pne$year)}; ",
  "{sum(!pne$time_known)} without a usable start time; ",
  "{sum(!is.na(pne$netid_swfsc))} already carry an SWFSC NetId"), "\n")
```

### Net types and preservatives

```{r}
#| label: pne-net-types

pne |>
  count(net_type, tow_type, preservative, net_side, name = "records") |>
  arrange(desc(records)) |>
  datatable(caption = "PIC net type → SWFSC tow type, preservative → net side")
```

## SWFSC nets in the release

Each released SWFSC net is a `sample` row of type `net` whose `source_uuid` is
SWFSC's NetId. Its side (port / starboard) comes from the `ichthyo_net` table.

```{r}
#| label: release-nets

con <- cc_get_db(version = version)
v   <- cc_latest_version()
if (version != "latest") v <- version
cat(glue("Release {v}"), "\n")

# net side arrives with `ichthyo_net` (from the SWFSC 2026-10-14 export on);
# without it every bongo record stops at its tow (`side_unknown`)
has_side <- "ichthyo_net" %in% dbListTables(con)
if (!has_side)
  cat("WARNING: this release has no ichthyo_net table, so no net side: bongo records match to the tow only\n")
side_sql <- if (has_side)
  "n.net_side, n.tow_number FROM sample s LEFT JOIN ichthyo_net n USING (sample_key)" else
  "NULL::VARCHAR AS net_side, NULL::INTEGER AS tow_number FROM sample s"

nets <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT
    s.sample_key         AS net_key,
    s.parent_sample_key  AS tow_key,
    lower(s.source_uuid::VARCHAR) AS net_uuid,
    s.cruise_key, s.site_key, s.tow_type,
    s.datetime           AS datetime_utc,
    s.latitude, s.longitude,
    c.ship_name, c.ship_nodc,
    {side_sql}
  LEFT JOIN cruise c USING (cruise_key)
  WHERE s.dataset_key = 'swfsc_ichthyo' AND s.sample_type = 'net'")) |>
  mutate(datetime_utc = force_tz(datetime_utc, "UTC"))

cat(glue(
  "{format(nrow(nets), big.mark = ',')} SWFSC nets on ",
  "{format(n_distinct(nets$tow_key), big.mark = ',')} tows, ",
  "{min(year(nets$datetime_utc), na.rm = TRUE)}–{max(year(nets$datetime_utc), na.rm = TRUE)}"), "\n")

nets |>
  count(tow_type, net_side, name = "nets") |>
  datatable(caption = "SWFSC nets by tow type and side")
```

## Match

```{r}
#| label: match

m <- pic_match_nets(
  pic  = pne |> filter(year >= 1951) |>
    select(pic_id, site_key, datetime_utc, latitude, longitude, tow_type, net_side),
  nets = nets |> filter(!is.na(datetime_utc)) |>
    select(net_key, tow_key, site_key, datetime_utc, latitude, longitude, tow_type, net_side))

xwalk <- pne |>
  left_join(m, by = "pic_id") |>
  mutate(status = if_else(year < 1951, "pre_1951", status)) |>
  left_join(
    nets |> select(net_key, net_uuid, cruise_key, swfsc_site_key = site_key,
                   swfsc_tow_type = tow_type, swfsc_net_side = net_side,
                   swfsc_datetime_utc = datetime_utc, ship_name_swfsc = ship_name,
                   ship_nodc),
    by = "net_key")

stopifnot(
  "one row per PIC record" = nrow(xwalk) == nrow(pne),
  "each SWFSC net is used once" = !anyDuplicated(na.omit(xwalk$net_uuid)))

xwalk |>
  count(status, name = "records") |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * records / sum(records), 1)) |>
  datatable(caption = "Match status, all PIC records")
```

### Of the nets SWFSC sorts

The rate that matters is over records whose net SWFSC sorts for
ichthyoplankton, from 1951.

```{r}
#| label: match-sorted

xwalk |>
  filter(!status %in% c("pre_1951", "not_sorted")) |>
  count(net_type, status, name = "records") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = records, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))),
         pct_matched = round(100 * matched / total, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  datatable(caption = "Match status by PIC net type (sorted nets, 1951+)")

xwalk |>
  filter(status == "matched") |>
  count(match_method, net_rule, name = "records") |>
  datatable(caption = "How matched records matched")
```

### By decade

```{r}
#| label: match-decade

xwalk |>
  filter(!status %in% c("pre_1951", "not_sorted")) |>
  mutate(decade = 10 * (year %/% 10)) |>
  count(decade, status, name = "records") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = records, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(pct_matched = round(100 * matched / rowSums(across(-decade)), 1)) |>
  datatable(caption = "Match status by decade (sorted nets)")
```

### Time check

PIC times are local Pacific Standard Time and the release keeps UTC. If the
conversion is right, a station match's released tow time minus its PIC start
time is near zero; an hour or eight-hour offset would show a time-zone slip.

```{r}
#| label: time-check

tc <- xwalk |>
  filter(status == "matched", match_method == "station", time_known) |>
  mutate(
    decade = 10 * (year %/% 10),
    dt_signed_hr = as.numeric(difftime(swfsc_datetime_utc, datetime_utc, units = "hours")))

tc |>
  group_by(decade) |>
  summarize(
    records          = n(),
    median_hr        = median(dt_signed_hr),
    pct_within_1h    = round(100 * mean(abs(dt_signed_hr) <= 1), 1),
    pct_off_by_7_9h  = round(100 * mean(abs(dt_signed_hr) >= 7 & abs(dt_signed_hr) <= 9), 1)) |>
  datatable(caption = "Released tow time − PIC start time (PST → UTC), station matches")
```

## Check against the known NetIds

```{r}
#| label: check-known

n_known    <- sum(!is.na(pne$netid_swfsc))
n_in_rel   <- sum(pne$netid_swfsc %in% nets$net_uuid)
cat(glue(
  "{n_in_rel} of {n_known} NetIds already given by PIC are in release {v} ",
  "(cruises {paste(sort(unique(pne$expedition_code[!is.na(pne$netid_swfsc)])), collapse = ', ')}); ",
  "SWFSC nets in the release run through {max(year(nets$datetime_utc), na.rm = TRUE)}"), "\n")

chk <- xwalk |>
  filter(!is.na(netid_swfsc)) |>
  mutate(agree = case_when(
    is.na(net_uuid)              ~ "not matched",
    net_uuid == netid_swfsc      ~ "same NetId",
    TRUE                         ~ "different NetId"))

chk |> count(agree, name = "records") |> datatable(caption = "Known NetIds reproduced?")

chk |>
  filter(agree != "same NetId") |>
  select(pic_id, expedition_code, site_key, date, start_hhmm, net_type, preservative,
         netid_swfsc, net_uuid, status, match_method, net_rule, dt_hr, dist_km) |>
  datatable(caption = "Known NetIds the match does not reproduce")
```

## What did not match

`no_candidate`: no SWFSC tow of that type at that station within 36 h, nor
within 5 km and 12 h. `no_net`: the tow was found but its net could not be
picked (a two-net bongo with no preservative, or no net on that side).
`conflict`: another PIC record claimed the same net more closely.

```{r}
#| label: unmatched-cruises

cruise_ym <- nets |>
  distinct(cruise_key) |>
  mutate(ym = substr(cruise_key, 1, 7))

xwalk |>
  filter(status %in% c("no_candidate", "no_net", "conflict")) |>
  mutate(ym = format(date, "%Y-%m"),
         swfsc_has_month = ym %in% cruise_ym$ym) |>
  count(expedition_code, ym, swfsc_has_month, status, name = "records") |>
  arrange(desc(records)) |>
  datatable(caption = "Unmatched sorted records by expedition (swfsc_has_month: the release has an SWFSC cruise that month)")
```

```{r}
#| label: unmatched-map

um <- xwalk |>
  filter(status == "no_candidate", !is.na(latitude)) |>
  count(site_key, latitude, longitude, name = "records")

leaflet(um) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~longitude, ~latitude, radius = ~ pmin(12, 2 + sqrt(records)),
    stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.5,
    label = ~ glue("{site_key}: {records} unmatched"),
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions())
```

## Crosswalk

One row per PIC record, written as CSV for Linsey Sala and Ed Weber to review.
`net_uuid` is SWFSC's NetId; `net_key` is the same net in the CalCOFI
database.

```{r}
#| label: write-crosswalk

out <- xwalk |>
  transmute(
    ParentNetEventID_pk = pic_id, occurrence_uuid, expedition_code, date,
    start_hhmm, site_key, latitude, longitude, net_type, preservative,
    status, net_uuid, net_key, cruise_key, swfsc_site_key, swfsc_tow_type,
    swfsc_net_side, swfsc_datetime_utc, match_method, net_rule,
    dt_hr = round(dt_hr, 2), dist_km = round(dist_km, 2), netid_swfsc_given = netid_swfsc)

csv <- path(dir_out, glue("sio_pic-zooplankton_pne_to_swfsc_ichthyo_net_{v}.csv"))
write_csv(out, csv, na = "")
cat(glue("Wrote {format(nrow(out), big.mark = ',')} rows to {csv}"), "\n")

out |> filter(status == "matched") |> head(500) |>
  datatable(caption = "First 500 matched rows")
```

## Next steps

- Linsey Sala and Ed Weber review the `no_candidate`, `no_net` and `conflict`
  rows; Ed can screen them against the SWFSC database.
- Once agreed, the NetIds can go into the PIC database (`NetID_SWFSC`) and the
  `sio_pic-zooplankton` ingest can read the PNE table and carry the NetId, so
  the release links PIC and SWFSC nets directly.
